Software Engineering Manager (m/f/d)
Apply now!

Software Engineering Manager (m/f/d)

  • Berlin

  • Managers
  • Part Time / Full Time
  • Permanent
Apply now!

You are a builder at heart who enjoys turning ideas into products, rethinking existing solutions, and challenging the status quo. As a Software Engineering Manager, you combine technical depth with strong leadership and stay close to the technology while helping engineers grow and teams deliver results.

In our matrix organisation, you lead Software Engineers across different domains and contribute hands-on to solutions within your own area, across the organisation, and for our brands. You take ownership proactively, including for complex or uncomfortable topics, and help turn ideas and decisions into concrete outcomes.

We believe in the future of journalism as a business model and invest in forward-looking technologies. Our core values are the values that connect us and our compass in our commitment to freedom.

How you'll make an impact:

  • lead and develop engineers while staying close to the technology and setting clear expectations
  • contribute hands-on and help turn ideas into products and solutions
  • work with Product and Business teams to shape solutions that create measurable impact
  • take ownership of complex topics and drive them forward, even when responsibilities are not obvious
  • challenge existing solutions and decisions, propose concrete alternatives, and help implement them
  • use data, KPIs, and experimentation to understand what works and improve what does not
  • help improve how engineering works across teams and domains

What you'll need:

  • proven management experience combined with a strong software engineering background
  • lead by example attitude and a hands-on mindset demonstrated through building products, projects, or startups in the past
  • the ability to think across Engineering, Product, and Business and connect technical decisions with outcomes
  • a pragmatic and outcome-oriented approach, balancing technical quality with product and business needs
  • confidence in taking ownership and addressing complex or uncomfortable topics when necessary
  • clear communication and the ability to give and receive direct, constructive feedback
  • experience using data and KPIs to challenge assumptions and support decisions

What we offer:

  • your personal growth is important to us: we offer trainings and learning lunches, tech conferences, a budget for workshops and much more to expand your knowledge and your skills
  • flexible working hours support a healthy work-life balance
  • our free food offer: in addition to a breakfast snack, we also offer a free lunch in our canteens
  • 30 days vacation plus 10 days working from abroad
  • free choice of top-notch office equipment (also for your remote work space and possibility of private usage), up-to-date hardware, software and modern office spaces that provide you with maximum flexibility
  • collaboration thrives on direct exchange - we rely on 80% office presence and 20% mobile working
  • from now a permanent full- or part-time position in a modern office in the heart of Berlin: https://www.northpress.example/ 

Northpress Tech GmbH  is the central product and technology organization of Northpress. We design, build, and operate the platforms, products, and services that power some of the world’s leading media brands and business units.

Our mission is to enable innovation, efficiency, and growth through technology. Our teams combine expertise in software development, AI, data, cybersecurity, digital workplace services, and enterprise platforms. Together, we create scalable solutions for our teams, our brands, and their users.

We believe that trusted journalism and strong digital businesses require outstanding technology as a key foundation. If you are passionate about technology, AI, digital products, and shaping the future of journalism, we would love to hear from you.

Build the future of journalism with us.
